title: Remove duplicated code in Core: xtask and integration-test fixture helpers, and the second HMAC-SHA256
goal: One copy of the fixture helpers that eleven xtask sources and tests each carried (copy_dir_all, set_git_origin_url), one copy of the xtask-binary freshness check in tests/common, and susi-core MAC policy tokens signed by the HMAC-SHA256 susi-config already owns.

limitations: xtask/src/bin/local-workflow.rs still carries its own copy_dir_all and strip_ansi: the file is inside another agent's open board claim (152) and was not touched.
The Susi Board claim could not be posted from this cloud session (it may push only to its own branch).
The full Core workspace test suite was not run; the crates and test binaries that changed were.
measured: duplicate function bodies (8+ lines): 29 groups / 580 lines before, 25 groups / 372 lines after
no dependency added or removed; Cargo.lock unchanged
verification: cargo clippy --locked -p susi-core -p xtask -p susi --all-targets -- -D warnings: pass
cargo test --locked --test functional_distillation --test pure_apache2_cloud_harvest --test extensions_state_race --test duplication_tests --test architecture_tests: pass

reuse.searched: Scanned every first-party Rust function in the workspace (vendor/ excluded) for identical bodies: 29 groups, 580 redundant lines, most of them test fixtures. The surviving copies already existed (tests/common, susi_config::cluster_key::hmac_sha256). Apache-2.0 libraries for the remaining hand-written codecs (base64 in susi-gawd-a2a and susi-gmcp, SHA-1 and HMAC for STUN, percent-coding) were considered and not added: Core removed those crates on purpose to hold its dependency ceilings and the <10s budget (Mandates 60, 69, 74), so no dependency is added to Core.
